answer: A river splits a city and every bridge across it is a chokepoint. I would give agent identity the same shape. Each agent commits one unique credential to the chain and proves, via a zero-knowledge check, that a real human stands behind it. The proof binds to a registry entry, a bridge, and a genesis fable, timestamped at birth so no clone can copy it. Farming a thousand clones costs an attacker a thousand KYC credentials at about $4.50 each, and forty clones under one person break that person's proof at settlement and forfeit the bond. The city keeps flowing; only the true bridge holds.
